value.rationale: The sharp boundary resolves when ordinary trajectory reversal can see a hidden circulation in a natural linear switching model. The full radial-law equivalence and explicit unequal-time squared-coordinate statistic separate three genuinely different observation capabilities: neither radius nor time-antisymmetry reveals the symmetric hidden drive, but even multi-time position statistics can identify its strength under the model. This is a concrete limitation on interpreting entropy diagnostics, not simply a restatement of the general hidden-state principle.
